results.title: Kazuma Okamoto powers Blue Jays past Reds 6-5 as Toronto snaps three-game skid
results.description: TORONTO - Kazuma Okamoto hit two doubles, driving in three runs, to power the Toronto Blue Jays past the Cincinnati Reds 6-5 on Friday.

results.title: Duke Defeats Wake Forest, 3-2, in Conference Opener
results.description: Duke volleyball opened ACC play by winning a thrilling five-set match, 3-2 (22-25, 29-27, 25-18, 23-25, 15-10), over Wake Forest on Friday night inside Reynolds Gym.

results.title: Cubs vs. Red Sox game relocated to Tampa for Sunday
results.description: The Chicago Cubs and Boston Red Sox will have to play their final regular season game in Florida as a nor’easter batters the East Coast

results.title: Bears' injury report: Caleb Williams, Tyson Bagent miss practice
results.description: Caleb Williams and Tyson Bagent were absent from Bears’ practice Friday, and kicker Cairo Santos also remains on the team’s injury report

results.title: Friday football: Shawnee surge lifts Tribe past DHS
results.description: LIMA — Though Defiance forced a season-best four turnovers, the Bulldogs were unable to shake their losing skid on Friday in Lima as the Shawnee Indians pulled away for a 41-20 win.
